_help: One entry per recording. hesitations = how many um/uh/ah sounds you really made, counted as one group. fillers = your count of each other filler word. reference = the words you said, optional (it enables the word-mistake score). Use null for anything you haven't counted yet. pauses = how many silent gaps of 2 seconds or more you left on purpose. restarts = how many times you repeated a phrase. judge = your 0/1/2 score and one quoted phrase for each of the three things, using the guide in supabase/functions/_shared/prompts/judge.ts (guideVersion says which version). mainPoint is scored for clarity only. question = what you actually talked about.
